bugs_found: transfer is not atomic: source balance is debited before destination credit, so a failing account_to.balance + amount can leave funds lost
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal/finite, unlike other money functions; float/NaN/custom numeric inputs can raise unexpected errors or corrupt behavior
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without validation
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), changing repayment schedules without validation
fx_convert does not validate exchange rates are positive and finite, allowing negative/zero/NaN rates to produce invalid converted amounts
compound_interest does not validate principal is non-negative or finite
